We need to generate new test cases for getSchema(URI) avoiding duplicates. Existing groups cover valid URIs (classpath, file, http), invalid non-existent resources, null, malformed, and config propagation. Need other scenarios: URI with query parameters, fragment, relative URI, custom scheme (e.g., jar:), URI with spaces, URI pointing to YAML schema with input format detection? But getSchema(URI) uses default config and default input format detection based on file extension? Actually getSchema(URI) just calls getSchema(SchemaLocation.of(schemaUri.toString()), createSchemaValidatorsConfig()). So it will treat URI string as schema location; if ends with .yaml maybe load as YAML? The factory likely determines format via content type detection. We can test a URI with .yaml extension to ensure YAML parsing works. Also test a URI with encoded characters (space %20). Also test a URI that points to a directory (should fail). Also test a URI with scheme "http" but using custom SchemaLoader that fails? Not accessible.

Also test concurrency: calling getSchema concurrently on same URI returns cached? Not sure if caching exists. There's a ConcurrentMap maybe for schema cache.

We can test that calling getSchema with same URI twice returns same instance (or at least not reloaded). Could be a behavior.

Also test that a URI with fragment identifier is ignored? Eg "classpath:/schemas/simple-schema.json#". Expect same schema.

Also test that a URI with uppercase scheme (FILE) works.

Also test that a URI with relative path (new URI("simple-schema.json"))? but toString maybe relative; may cause loader to treat as classpath? Not sure.

We'll produce groups: "URI with YAML extension", "URI with encoded characters", "URI with fragment identifier", "Repeated calls caching behavior", "URI with unsupported scheme". Also "URI pointing to directory" expecting exception.

For caching: expected same instance (==) or same underlying schemaNode.
